tool.name: RADAR-PD Result Explorer
tool.description: inspect reports and scientific artifacts in an interactive NDIP session
tool.command: #import re set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p site/{plots,tables,phases,gpx} && cp '$report' site/index.html && cp '$summary' site/summary.json && #if str($plots) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $plots #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/plots/$name' && #end for #end if #if str($tables) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $tables #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/tables/$name' && #end for #end if #if str($phases) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $phases #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/phases/$name' && #end for #end if #if str($gpx_projects) not in ('', 'None', 'Not available.') #for $item in $gpx_projects #set $name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) cp '$item' 'site/gpx/$name' && #end for #end if printf '%s\n' 'RADAR-PD interactive result explorer started on port 8080.' > '$session_log' && python -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory site
tool.help: Starts an NDIP interactive session containing the normalized RADAR-PD report and selected artifact collections. Galaxy remains the system of record for datasets and provenance. This explorer is for inspection and download; editing a GPX project requires the separate interactive GSAS-II handoff tool planned for NDIP deployment.
